source_incident: Sample: After an inference workstation reboot, the first model response takes about 45 seconds; later responses take 2-3 seconds. GPU placement and model-load timing have not been checked. No customer outage is reported.

reported_facts: After an inference workstation reboot, the first model response takes approximately 45 seconds.
Subsequent model responses take between 2 and 3 seconds.
GPU placement has not been checked.
Model-load timing has not been checked.
unknowns: Whether GPU placement affects response times post-reboot.
Whether model-load timing contributes to the initial delay.
The exact sequence of events during startup that leads to the first response delay.
next_checks: Verify GPU utilization and temperature during the first response after reboot using non-destructive monitoring tools.
Check for any visible or logged delays in model loading or initialization sequences without interrupting ongoing operations.
Monitor system logs for timing events related to GPU resource allocation or model initialization.
brief.handoff_note: No customer outage is reported. Observations are limited to response time differences post-reboot; no root cause has been identified. Non-destructive checks recommended to assess hardware and software state without impacting service.
